0022600154.text: The Boston Celtics (3-1, 3-0 at home, W3 streak, 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East) visit the Orlando Magic (1-3, 0-2 at home, L1 streak, 4th in the Southeast and 11th in the East). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 113-108 win in Boston on April 12, 2026. Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain).
